summary: All three spec items are in the diff and do what the spec asks: scripts/_smoke_check.py checks docs/_smoke/unit-2.md exists, is a regular file and has non-whitespace text (exit 0/1); the doc exists and is non-empty; the test file has 9 cases covering every branch plus two subprocess round-trips. Extras (invalid-UTF-8 handling, cwd-independent root) are defensive parts of the same check, not scope creep. Known path deviation: spec L5 names tests/test_smoke_unit2.py; the test lives at shared/tests/test_smoke_unit2.py, recorded in the mini-plan (L9-11) with the reason (no repo-root tests/, one-test-root conftest rule) and permitted by the orchestrator brief - an approved, recorded deviation that changes no behaviour. ACs are TBD (L9), so scope line L5 is the contract, and it is met. Verdict from reading code against spec; tests not run by the reviewer.
